text: Zoho to Claude? Five routes, not one.
Two routes bring Zoho data into Claude. Three put Claude to work inside Zoho.
No. 1: Zoho's own connectors in Claude's directory. Fast, but some tools delete records.
No. 2: your own Zoho MCP server. Only the tools you choose.
No. 3: an Anthropic key in Zia Agents or Zoho Creator.
No. 4: Zoho Flow. A new lead sends text to Claude, with no code.
No. 5: a Deluge function that calls the Claude API. Full control.
Whichever you choose, start read-only. Keep every change behind an approval.
Read the full guide at zudoworks.com
